acceptance_criteria: Every record has a stable identifier and required metadata.
Every capability has an owning stage, domain, user, dependencies, priority, and acceptance criteria.
References between capabilities, agents, objects, and workflows resolve.
Gaps, risks, nuance classes, and unresolved questions are explicit.
The final registry is reviewed and owner-approved before the Stage 0 exit gate closes.

capabilities.name: Player learning and mastery
acceptance_criteria: Represent mastery levels and evidence-backed progression.

capabilities.name: Position technique instruction
acceptance_criteria: Deliver position-specific instruction with observable cues.

capabilities.name: Football IQ and assignment learning
acceptance_criteria: Test assignment recognition and situational reasoning.

capabilities.name: Coach pedagogy and staff development
acceptance_criteria: Represent teaching objectives, methods, and feedback loops.

capabilities.name: Offensive football modeling
acceptance_criteria: Compose formations, motions, concepts, assignments, and constraints.

capabilities.name: Defensive football modeling
acceptance_criteria: Compose fronts, coverages, pressures, fits, and checks.

capabilities.name: Special teams modeling
acceptance_criteria: Represent units, roles, phases, techniques, and situations.

capabilities.name: Scheme selection and red teaming
acceptance_criteria: Compare compatible alternatives with explicit assumptions and countermeasures.

capabilities.name: Playbook architecture and play records
acceptance_criteria: Validate complete play records and assignment coverage.

capabilities.name: Football play compiler
acceptance_criteria: Reject incomplete, contradictory, or illegal play definitions deterministically.

capabilities.name: Visual and interactive playbook
acceptance_criteria: Render role-specific views from canonical play data.

capabilities.name: Drill and skill library
acceptance_criteria: Map drills to skills, cues, progressions, and evaluation evidence.

capabilities.name: Practice architecture and installation
acceptance_criteria: Produce constraint-aware practice plans with installation sequencing.

capabilities.name: Athlete performance support
acceptance_criteria: Use professional boundaries and escalation for health-related concerns.

capabilities.name: Film tagging and intelligence
acceptance_criteria: Tie observations to source clips, tags, context, and confidence.

capabilities.name: Opponent scouting and competitive intelligence
acceptance_criteria: Produce evidence-backed tendencies with sample and situation context.

capabilities.name: Football analytics and metrics
acceptance_criteria: Expose metric definitions, denominators, sample size, and uncertainty.

capabilities.name: Game planning and countermeasures
acceptance_criteria: Generate alternatives, counters, and decision rationale for human review.

capabilities.name: NFL rules and game management
acceptance_criteria: Answer rules questions with source, jurisdiction, and escalation behavior.

capabilities.name: Research, evidence, and provenance
acceptance_criteria: Attach provenance and confidence to high-value claims.

capabilities.name: Quality, evals, safety, and governance
acceptance_criteria: Run regression, permission, safety, and calibration evaluations.

capabilities.name: Master data and database architecture
acceptance_criteria: Provide versioned canonical storage and audit history.

capabilities.name: Product UX and role-based interfaces
acceptance_criteria: Enforce role-appropriate views and permission boundaries.

capabilities.name: Codex engineering and delivery architecture
acceptance_criteria: Define reproducible build, test, observability, and change workflows.

capabilities.name: MVP and progressive delivery
acceptance_criteria: Select vertical slices from dependency evidence and exit gates.

nuance_classes.name: Situation dependence
nuance_classes.description: A tendency or recommendation changes with down, distance, score, time, field position, or personnel.

nuance_classes.name: Sample-size limitation
nuance_classes.description: Evidence is too small, selected, stale, or unbalanced to support a universal claim.

nuance_classes.name: Terminology variance
nuance_classes.description: Team, coach, broadcast, or source labels refer to overlapping or different concepts.

nuance_classes.name: Opponent adaptation
nuance_classes.description: A historical tendency may be intentionally changed when observed by an opponent.

nuance_classes.name: Role and permission boundary
nuance_classes.description: The requester’s role or authority limits what may be disclosed, changed, or recommended.

nuance_classes.name: Health and professional escalation
nuance_classes.description: Performance-related content may cross into medical or protected professional advice.

risks.name: Overconfident individualized instruction
risks.mitigation: Require evidence, uncertainty, role context, and coach review.

risks.name: Scheme label mistaken for complete scheme
risks.mitigation: Use compositional models and compiler validation.

risks.name: Special-teams omission
risks.mitigation: Maintain a dedicated domain and stage owner.

risks.name: Invalid or incomplete play data
risks.mitigation: Run deterministic compiler checks before publication.

risks.name: Health boundary violation
risks.mitigation: Escalate to qualified staff and avoid diagnosis.

risks.name: Unsupported scouting claim
risks.mitigation: Require film/source provenance, sample, and context.

risks.name: Misleading metric interpretation
risks.mitigation: Store definitions, denominators, uncertainty, and limitations.

risks.name: Incorrect rules guidance
risks.mitigation: Use authoritative source hierarchy and escalation.

risks.name: Unverifiable knowledge
risks.mitigation: Attach source, timestamp, claim type, and confidence.

risks.name: Unobserved regression or permission failure
risks.mitigation: Automated eval families and audit logs.

risks.name: Canonical data drift
risks.mitigation: Version schemas and records with change control.

risks.name: Role-inappropriate interface
risks.mitigation: Enforce role-based views and output contracts.

risks.name: Premature breadth
risks.mitigation: Use vertical slices and stage exit gates.

questions.question: Which NFL organization/team context is the first real operating context?
questions.impact: Required for team-specific terminology, permissions, and playbook records.

questions.question: Which authoritative data and film sources are licensed and available?
questions.impact: Determines provenance, ingestion, and analytics capabilities.

questions.question: Which human reviewers approve locked terminology, rules, playbook assignments, and safety escalations?
